desc:
💣 Launch nukes at a living cartoon world and get paid for every block you break. Real craters, collapsing towers, burning districts - the city rebuilds, so the destruction never runs out.

🚀 Fire missiles, MIRVs & carpet runs
🌆 Flatten towns, cities & the downtown skyline
💥 Watch real mushroom clouds & shockwaves
💰 Every chunk destroyed pays cash
🔬 Earn research & climb the tech tree
🏭 Upgrade your base for passive income
♻️ Prestige for permanent multipliers
🎯 Devastation ratings - chase the D5 APOCALYPSE

🎁 Daily rewards & login streaks
🗓️ New bombs added in updates - 33 and counting
👥 Shared map - race friends to the richest districts

Advanced destruction sim: per-building damage, structural collapse, fire spread, and terrain craters that heal over time.

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards

⚠️ Early Access - Updates in progress
